newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: YUGOSLAV JULY PRODUCER PRICES RISE 0.3 PCT VS JUNE.
newsitem.headline: YUGOSLAV JULY PRODUCER PRICES RISE 0.3 PCT VS JUNE.

text.p: reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV PRODUCER PRICES JULY JUNE JULY 96
NOTES -- Cumulative January-July PPI rose 24.8 percent against the same period last year and was up 18.3 percent on the 1996 average.
July PPI rose 19.1 percent against the average in 1996 and 5.0 percent on December last year.
Figures refer to the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 311 4305
